title: Ronaldo SIUUU
blurb: Cristiano Ronaldo has explained that the cry is simply the Portuguese sim — yes — stretched to breaking point, which is a wonderfully mundane origin for the most imitated sound in world football. Every schoolyard, every FIFA lobby, every child who has ever jumped, spun and landed with their arms out after scoring anything at all. It is less a word than a formal declaration of superiority, and it works precisely because it is impossible to perform modestly. Play it after any victory, however small, and commit fully to the landing.
